card.title: City Beneath
card.summary: Xinhai never goes dark. Every day the city system Skyvault reports that all is normal — until the campus arena loses power and the report still says supply is normal.
card.quote: If this city has no underground, then who is making the sound beneath our feet?

rc001-p0.title: Prologue · A Card That Doesn't Exist
rc001-p0.summary: The arena goes dark, but the system insists power is fine. In the switch room you find a card that is on no inventory list.

p0-intro.speaker: Narrator
p0-intro.text: The whole campus arena went dark in three seconds. Some of the crowd was still clapping, assuming it was part of the show. You open the terminal; Skyvault's report pops up: energy supply normal.

p0-ai.speaker: Skyvault
p0-ai.text: Anomalous object detected. According to the database, the item you just picked up does not exist. Please put it down.

p0-choice.prompt: The terminal waits. The crowd starts to stir.
options: Then what is this thing in my hand?
Forget it — just fix the power.

p0-ai-ask.speaker: Skyvault
p0-ai-ask.text: Recommendation: stop holding a non-existent object. Repeat: stop holding a non-existent object.

p0-ai-fix.speaker: Skyvault
p0-ai-fix.text: Energy supply is normal. Therefore the outage does not exist. Since the outage does not exist, the darkness you see is a visual error.

p0-battle.title: Switch Room
p0-battle.brief: Every maintenance bot is offline, yet they are still moving. Clear two waves to keep digging.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Emergency lights flicker; vision comes and goes

skills.name: Wrench Sweep
skills.description: Mechanical arm sweeps, knocking targets back

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Switch cabinets overload; the floor discharges

p0-reward.title: The Card Is Warm
p0-reward.description: You pull it from the gap in the cabinet. It doesn't feel discarded — it's warm, as if someone has been holding it.

p0-end.title: Prologue Complete
p0-end.text: You push it into the terminal. The screen doesn't ask whether to read it. It just starts.

rc001-p1.title: Act I · Platform Zero
rc001-p1.summary: The memory coordinates point at a name erased from the city map: Level Zero. The platform is still there, and the sign is still calling trains.

p1-intro.speaker: Narrator
p1-intro.text: The moment the memory core loads, you are no longer in the arena. The air tastes of rust and old standing water. You are standing on a platform, and the display overhead is announcing a stop — Level Zero. The city map has no such place.

p1-station.speaker: Narrator
p1-station.text: The platform is too clean. No dust on the seats, not a single dead tube light, as if someone still cleans it every day. Just no one left to sit.

p1-choice.prompt: The signal is weak, and security has already noticed you.
options: Head straight down to the tracks

p1-warn.speaker: Narrator
p1-warn.text: Red light sweeps the bottom of the stairs. You count three passes; every fourth sweep leaves a gap — enough for one person, not two.

p1-objective.title: Pin Down the Coordinates
p1-objective.description: Nail down two things before going deeper.
goals: Confirm the coordinates are locked on Level Zero
Locate the exact position of the signal

p1-battle.title: Unmanned Security
p1-battle.brief: The security system has no name and needs none. Keep hitting it until it loses power.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Platform lights die; only red dots move

skills.name: Scan Lock
skills.description: Locks a target and briefly roots it

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Every gate drops; the way back is sealed

skills.name: Shock Baton
skills.description: Melee combo; the last hit stuns

p1-archive.speaker: Narrator
p1-archive.text: In the console you find an old archive. Seventeen years ago, Level Zero had three thousand seven hundred registered residents. You check the names one by one against the current population database — none of them. Not dead, not relocated. Never existed.

p1-reward.title: The First Memory
p1-reward.description: The archive copies into your terminal. It is only 4 MB, and it holds more than three thousand people.

p1-end.title: Act I Complete
p1-end.text: Memory core notice: the next segment requires full clearance. The clearance is locked deeper down.

rc001-p2.title: Act II · The Unregistered
rc001-p2.summary: The underground facility used to be lived in. After one system upgrade, every record here was marked as bad data.

p2-intro.speaker: Narrator
p2-intro.text: Back on the surface you pull up the zoning map. The official line is "underground utility corridor, uninhabited." Corridors don't need three thousand seven hundred beds.

p2-db.speaker: Skyvault
p2-db.text: These records are marked as bad data. Bad data is purged per procedure. Purge complete. You are viewing a purged file.

p2-stranger.speaker: Stranger
p2-stranger.text: You dig carefully. Too bad the city didn't forget them — someone made the city forget.

p2-choice.prompt: His voice is calm, too calm for someone asking to be saved.

p2-press.speaker: Stranger
p2-press.text: If I tell you now, you won't keep walking. Get through the lockdown first. We'll meet at the core.

p2-battle.title: Lockdown Zone
p2-battle.brief: The security detail has held this line for seventeen years. Their last order was: let no one go down.

skills.name: Shield Advance
skills.description: Advances behind a shield and knocks targets back

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Blast gates drop one by one; the arena narrows

skills.name: Throat Cut
skills.description: Extremely high execute chance against low-health targets

p2-after.speaker: Narrator
p2-after.text: When the last one fell, his visor cracked open. The face inside was young — too young to have guarded this place for seventeen years.

p2-reward.title: The Second Memory
p2-reward.description: The door at the end of the passage opens. No light behind it, only deep wind.

p2-end.title: Act II Complete
p2-end.text: Memory core notice: final clearance zone. High-intensity defense system detected.

rc001-p3.title: Finale · Memory Core
rc001-p3.summary: The data center is still here. The deleted records were never destroyed — only compressed into fragments no one can read.

p3-intro.speaker: Narrator
p3-intro.text: The deepest level isn't a server room. It's a data center. Three thousand seven hundred names stand in columns here, every column crushed into a fragment that cannot be opened.

p3-archive.speaker: Narrator
p3-archive.text: They were never destroyed. Destruction is irreversible, and "irreversible" needs a signature. Nobody would sign. So they were left here, waiting for someone to read.

p3-battle.title: Final Defense
p3-battle.brief: The defense system is the last safeguard. It doesn't know you — only the order: no reading.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Data pods vent; your footing gets pushed around

skills.name: Clear Pulse
skills.description: Ring pulse that knocks back nearby targets

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Coolant leaks; the floor turns slick

skills.name: Sound Suppression
skills.description: Sustained soundwave that slows and damages

waves.label: Wave 3
waves.event: All lighting turns red; no cover left

p3-reveal.speaker: Narrator
p3-reveal.text: The defense system goes quiet. You finally see the face — not someone who was alive seventeen years ago. Younger than you expected, and older than this memory.

p3-truth.speaker: Stranger
p3-truth.text: I'm not a survivor. I'm this card. After they deleted everyone, they left me here to remember for them. Now you've read it. Your turn.

p3-last.speaker: Narrator
p3-last.text: The last line of the archive lights up on its own: Memory core reader — identity match failed. Matched subject: current reader.

p3-choice.prompt: You have one choice left: take this memory with you, or let it end for good.
options: Save this memory and take it out
Destroy it — let all three thousand seven hundred end

p3-reward-keep.title: You Took It
p3-reward-keep.description: The card is hot when it leaves the terminal. You slide it into an inside pocket, against your chest.

p3-end-keep.title: Ending · Someone Remembers
p3-end-keep.text: The next day Skyvault publishes its report as usual: energy supply normal, population data normal. You add a line under it in small type — three thousand seven hundred and fourteen. The system doesn't delete it. It doesn't acknowledge it either.

p3-reward-burn.title: You Pressed Destroy
p3-reward-burn.description: The fragments go out one after another. No sound, no ash.

p3-end-burn.title: Ending · The City Got Quieter
p3-end-burn.text: The city didn't lose power that night. You stood at the corner and listened for a long time. Nothing came from under your feet. You can't tell whether this is the end, or whether they finally finished deleting.
